hint: Hover or tap the highlighted parts to see what each one becomes.

parts.title: Type
parts.text: `fetch` → `GET`, `create` → `POST`, `replace` → `PUT`, `update` → `PATCH`, `delete` → `DELETE`, `dispatch` → `POST`. Also sets MCP hints such as “read-only”.

parts.title: Name
parts.text: Identifier and route: `/typo3/api/my-extension/page/{uid}/titles`. Becomes the MCP tool `fetch_my_extension_page_by_uid_titles`.

parts.match: summary: 'Fetch the titles of a page'
parts.title: Summary
parts.text: Documentation for developers in OpenAPI and for AI agents in the tool list.

parts.title: Scopes
parts.text: The caller must be granted all listed scopes, otherwise the call is rejected.

parts.title: Parameters
parts.text: Become the input JSON Schema. Values come from the route, the query string or the JSON body, and are validated and converted to PHP types.

parts.title: ActionContext
parts.text: Not part of the schema. Passed in automatically: TYPO3 context, user, translator, request and granted scopes.

parts.title: Return type
parts.text: PHPDoc types like `list<string>` or array shapes become the output schema. The result is validated before it is returned.

parts.match: @throws NotFoundError if the page does not exist
parts.title: Declared errors
parts.text: Errors must be declared with `@throws`. `NotFoundError` becomes a documented `404`, `PermissionDeniedError` a `403`.
